atoms.text:
Benny the turtle pirate is captain of his ship. The ship is very large and has a kitchen. The ship’s starfish cook is named Enzo. Enzo often cooks soup. He puts in broth and barnacles. He likes making tasty things. Sometimes, he gets upset.

“Benny!” yells Enzo, “steer smoothly, my soup just spilled!”

Benny likes Enzo’s soup. But the ocean has waves. He cannot always steer smoothly.

Benny says, “Enzo, I told you today was windy. You could have made sandwiches!”

Enzo likes to make what he wants. The barnacles needed to be used. Benny and Enzo sit down to talk.

“Ay,” says Enzo, “You did warn me. I will try to make sandwiches next time.”

Benny replies, “I really like your soup, Enzo. I like that you care about what we eat.”

They ate soup together. It was delicious.
